views.name: aibs_broad_types_merged
views.definition:
WITH baylor AS (
         SELECT subquery.id,
            subquery.created,
            subquery.deleted,
            subquery.superceded_id,
            subquery.valid,
            subquery.target_id,
            subquery.classification_system,
            subquery.cell_type,
            subquery.row_num
           FROM ( SELECT baylor_log_reg_cell_type_coarse_v1.id,
                    baylor_log_reg_cell_type_coarse_v1.created,
                    baylor_log_reg_cell_type_coarse_v1.deleted,
                    baylor_log_reg_cell_type_coarse_v1.superceded_id,
                    baylor_log_reg_cell_type_coarse_v1.valid,
                    baylor_log_reg_cell_type_coarse_v1.target_id,
                    baylor_log_reg_cell_type_coarse_v1.classification_system,
                    baylor_log_reg_cell_type_coarse_v1.cell_type,
                    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY baylor_log_reg_cell_type_coarse_v1.target_id ORDER BY baylor_log_reg_cell_type_coarse_v1.cell_type) AS row_num
                   FROM baylor_log_reg_cell_type_coarse_v1) subquery
          WHERE subquery.row_num = 1
        )
 SELECT COALESCE(ct.target_id, multifeature.target_id, baylor.target_id) AS target_id,
        CASE
            WHEN ct.classification_system_source <> 'aibs_metamodel_celltypes_v661'::text AND ct.classification_system IS NOT NULL THEN replace(ct.classification_system, '_neuron'::text, ''::text)
            WHEN multifeature.classification_system IS NOT NULL THEN multifeature.classification_system::text
            WHEN baylor.cell_type IS NOT NULL THEN replace(baylor.cell_type::text, '_neuron'::text, ''::text)
            ELSE replace(ct.classification_system, '_neuron'::text, ''::text)
        END AS broad_type,
        CASE
            WHEN ct.classification_system_source <> 'aibs_metamodel_celltypes_v661'::text AND ct.classification_system IS NOT NULL THEN ct.classification_system_source
            WHEN multifeature.classification_system IS NOT NULL THEN 'cell_type_multifeature_combo'::text
            WHEN baylor.cell_type IS NOT NULL THEN 'baylor_log_reg_cell_type_coarse_v1'::text
            ELSE ct.classification_system_source
        END AS broad_type_source
   FROM aibs_cell_types_merged ct
     FULL JOIN baylor ON ct.target_id = baylor.target_id
     FULL JOIN cell_type_multifeature_combo multifeature ON COALESCE(ct.target_id, baylor.target_id) = multifeature.target_id;

views.name: aibs_cell_info
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT nucs.id,
    nucs.pt_root_id,
    nucs.pt_supervoxel_id,
    nucs.pt_position,
    nucs.volume AS nuc_volume,
    broad.broad_type,
    broad.broad_type_source,
    cell.cell_type,
    cell.cell_type_source,
    mtypes.mtype,
    mtypes.mtype_source,
    COALESCE(proof.dendrite_cleaned, false) AS dendrite_cleaned,
    COALESCE(proof.axon_cleaned, false) AS axon_cleaned,
    proof.dendrite_strategy,
    proof.axon_strategy,
    func_area.tag AS visual_area,
    multifeature.cell_type AS meso_type
   FROM nucleus_detection_lookup_v1 nucs
     LEFT JOIN aibs_broad_types_merged broad ON nucs.id = broad.target_id
     LEFT JOIN aibs_cell_types_merged cell ON nucs.id = cell.target_id
     LEFT JOIN aibs_mtypes_merged mtypes ON nucs.id = mtypes.target_id
     LEFT JOIN bdp_proofreading_status_and_strategy proof ON nucs.pt_root_id = proof.pt_root_id
     LEFT JOIN nucleus_functional_area_assignment func_area ON nucs.id = func_area.target_id
     LEFT JOIN cell_type_multifeature_combo multifeature ON nucs.id = multifeature.target_id;

views.name: aibs_cell_info_pos
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    pt_root_id,
    pt_supervoxel_id,
    st_x(pt_position) AS pt_position_x,
    st_y(pt_position) AS pt_position_y,
    st_z(pt_position) AS pt_position_z,
    nuc_volume,
    broad_type,
    broad_type_source,
    cell_type,
    cell_type_source,
    mtype,
    mtype_source,
    dendrite_cleaned,
    axon_cleaned,
    dendrite_strategy,
    axon_strategy,
    visual_area
   FROM aibs_cell_info info;

views.name: aibs_cell_types_merged
views.definition:
SELECT COALESCE(corrections.target_id, multifeature.target_id, base.target_id) AS target_id,
    COALESCE(corrections.classification_system, multifeature.classification_system::text, base.classification_system::text) AS classification_system,
    COALESCE(corrections.cell_type, base.cell_type) AS cell_type,
    COALESCE(corrections.classification_system_source,
        CASE
            WHEN multifeature.classification_system IS NOT NULL THEN 'cell_type_multifeature_combo'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END, 'aibs_metamodel_celltypes_v661'::text) AS classification_system_source,
    COALESCE(corrections.cell_type_source, 'aibs_metamodel_celltypes_v661'::text) AS cell_type_source
   FROM aibs_metamodel_celltypes_v661 base
     FULL JOIN aibs_manual_cell_types corrections ON base.target_id = corrections.target_id
     FULL JOIN cell_type_multifeature_combo multifeature ON COALESCE(corrections.target_id, base.target_id) = multifeature.target_id;

views.name: aibs_manual_cell_types
views.definition:
WITH processed_corrections AS (
         SELECT corrections_1.target_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN lower(corrections_1.classification_system::text) = 'excitatory_neuron'::text THEN 'excitatory'::text
                    WHEN lower(corrections_1.classification_system::text) = 'inhibitory_neuron'::text THEN 'inhibitory'::text
                    WHEN lower(corrections_1.classification_system::text) = 'nonneuron'::text THEN 'nonneuron'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS classification_system,
                CASE
                    WHEN lower(corrections_1.cell_type::text) ~~ '%unsure%'::text THEN NULL::character varying
                    WHEN corrections_1.cell_type::text = '5P-PT'::text THEN '5P-ET'::character varying
                    ELSE corrections_1.cell_type
                END AS cell_type
           FROM aibs_metamodel_celltypes_v661_corrections corrections_1
        ), processed_corrections2 AS (
         SELECT corrections2_1.target_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN lower(corrections2_1.classification_system::text) = 'excitatory_neuron'::text THEN 'excitatory'::text
                    WHEN lower(corrections2_1.classification_system::text) = 'inhibitory_neuron'::text THEN 'inhibitory'::text
                    WHEN lower(corrections2_1.classification_system::text) = 'nonneuron'::text THEN 'nonneuron'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS classification_system
           FROM aibs_metamodel_mtypes_v661_v2_corrections corrections2_1
        ), processed_slanted AS (
         SELECT slanted_1.target_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN lower(slanted_1.classification_system::text) = 'aibs_coarse_excitatory'::text THEN 'excitatory'::text
                    WHEN lower(slanted_1.classification_system::text) = 'aibs_coarse_inhibitory'::text THEN 'inhibitory'::text
                    WHEN lower(slanted_1.classification_system::text) = 'aibs_coarse_nonneuronal'::text THEN 'nonneuron'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS classification_system,
                CASE
                    WHEN lower(slanted_1.cell_type::text) ~~ '%unsure%'::text THEN NULL::character varying
                    WHEN slanted_1.cell_type::text = '5P-PT'::text THEN '5P-ET'::character varying
                    ELSE slanted_1.cell_type
                END AS cell_type
           FROM allen_v1_column_types_slanted_ref slanted_1
        ), processed_nonneuron AS (
         SELECT nonneuron_1.target_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN lower(nonneuron_1.classification_system::text) = 'aibs_coarse_excitatory'::text THEN 'excitatory'::text
                    WHEN lower(nonneuron_1.classification_system::text) = 'aibs_coarse_inhibitory'::text THEN 'inhibitory'::text
                    WHEN lower(nonneuron_1.classification_system::text) = 'aibs_coarse_nonneuronal'::text THEN 'nonneuron'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS classification_system,
                CASE
                    WHEN lower(nonneuron_1.cell_type::text) ~~ '%unsure%'::text THEN NULL::character varying
                    WHEN nonneuron_1.cell_type::text = '5P-PT'::text THEN '5P-ET'::character varying
                    ELSE nonneuron_1.cell_type
                END AS cell_type
           FROM aibs_column_nonneuronal_ref nonneuron_1
        )
 SELECT COALESCE(corrections2.target_id, corrections.target_id, slanted.target_id, nonneuron.target_id) AS target_id,
    COALESCE(corrections2.classification_system, corrections.classification_system, slanted.classification_system, nonneuron.classification_system) AS classification_system,
    COALESCE(corrections.cell_type, slanted.cell_type, nonneuron.cell_type) AS cell_type,
        CASE
            WHEN corrections2.classification_system IS NOT NULL THEN 'aibs_metamodel_mtypes_v661_v2_corrections'::text
            WHEN corrections.classification_system IS NOT NULL THEN 'aibs_metamodel_celltypes_v661_corrections'::text
            WHEN slanted.classification_system IS NOT NULL THEN 'allen_v1_column_types_slanted_ref'::text
            WHEN nonneuron.classification_system IS NOT NULL THEN 'aibs_column_nonneuronal_ref'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS classification_system_source,
        CASE
            WHEN corrections.cell_type IS NOT NULL THEN 'aibs_metamodel_celltypes_v661_corrections'::text
            WHEN slanted.cell_type IS NOT NULL THEN 'allen_v1_column_types_slanted_ref'::text
            WHEN nonneuron.cell_type IS NOT NULL THEN 'aibs_column_nonneuronal_ref'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS cell_type_source
   FROM processed_corrections corrections
     FULL JOIN processed_slanted slanted ON corrections.target_id = slanted.target_id
     FULL JOIN processed_nonneuron nonneuron ON COALESCE(corrections.target_id, slanted.target_id) = nonneuron.target_id
     FULL JOIN processed_corrections2 corrections2 ON COALESCE(corrections.target_id, slanted.target_id, nonneuron.target_id) = corrections2.target_id
  WHERE COALESCE(corrections.cell_type, slanted.cell_type, nonneuron.cell_type) IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(corrections2.classification_system, corrections.classification_system, slanted.classification_system, nonneuron.classification_system) IS NOT NULL;

views.name: aibs_metamodel_celltypes_v661_mv
views.definition:
SELECT 'cell_type'::text AS column_name,
    distinct_col1.col_value
   FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT aibs_metamodel_celltypes_v661.cell_type AS col_value
           FROM aibs_metamodel_celltypes_v661
          WHERE aibs_metamodel_celltypes_v661.cell_type IS NOT NULL) distinct_col1
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'classification_system'::text AS column_name,
    distinct_col2.col_value
   FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT aibs_metamodel_celltypes_v661.classification_system AS col_value
           FROM aibs_metamodel_celltypes_v661
          WHERE aibs_metamodel_celltypes_v661.classification_system IS NOT NULL) distinct_col2;

views.name: aibs_mtypes_merged
views.definition:
SELECT COALESCE(corrections.target_id, metamodel.target_id, col.target_id) AS target_id,
    COALESCE(corrections.cell_type, col.cell_type, metamodel.cell_type) AS mtype,
        CASE
            WHEN corrections.cell_type IS NOT NULL THEN 'aibs_metamodel_mtypes_v661_v2_corrections'::text
            WHEN col.cell_type IS NOT NULL THEN 'allen_column_mtypes_v2'::text
            ELSE 'aibs_metamodel_mtypes_v661_v2'::text
        END AS mtype_source
   FROM aibs_metamodel_mtypes_v661_v2 metamodel
     FULL JOIN allen_column_mtypes_v2 col ON metamodel.target_id = col.target_id
     FULL JOIN aibs_metamodel_mtypes_v661_v2_corrections corrections ON COALESCE(metamodel.target_id, col.target_id) = corrections.target_id;

views.name: bdp_proofreading_status_and_strategy
views.definition:
SELECT minnie3.pt_root_id,
    minnie3.pt_supervoxel_id,
    COALESCE(ps.status_dendrite, false) AS dendrite_cleaned,
    COALESCE(ps.status_axon, false) AS axon_cleaned,
    regexp_replace(ps.strategy_dendrite::text, '^dendrite_'::text, ''::text) AS dendrite_strategy,
    regexp_replace(ps.strategy_axon::text, '^axon_'::text, ''::text) AS axon_strategy
   FROM proofreading_status_and_strategy__minnie3_v1 minnie3
     JOIN proofreading_status_and_strategy ps ON minnie3.id = ps.id;

views.name: connections_with_nuclei
views.definition:
WITH synapse_grouped AS (
         SELECT synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.pre_pt_root_id,
            synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.post_pt_root_id,
            count(*) AS n_syn,
            sum(synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.size) AS sum_size
           FROM synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge
          WHERE synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.pre_pt_root_id <> synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.post_pt_root_id
          GROUP BY synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.pre_pt_root_id, synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.post_pt_root_id
        )
 SELECT sg.pre_pt_root_id,
    sg.post_pt_root_id,
    sg.n_syn,
    sg.sum_size,
    COALESCE(pre_nuclei.id, '-1'::integer::bigint) AS pre_nuc_id,
    COALESCE(post_nuclei.id, '-1'::integer::bigint) AS post_nuc_id
   FROM synapse_grouped sg
     LEFT JOIN single_neurons pre_nuclei ON sg.pre_pt_root_id = pre_nuclei.pt_root_id
     LEFT JOIN single_neurons post_nuclei ON sg.post_pt_root_id = post_nuclei.pt_root_id;

views.name: nucleus_alternative_points__minnie3_v1_merge
views.definition:
SELECT nucleus_alternative_points.id,
    nucleus_alternative_points.created,
    nucleus_alternative_points.deleted,
    nucleus_alternative_points.superceded_id,
    nucleus_alternative_points.valid,

    nucleus_alternative_points.pt_position,
    nucleus_alternative_points__minnie3_v1.pt_supervoxel_id,
    nucleus_alternative_points__minnie3_v1.pt_root_id
   FROM nucleus_alternative_points
     JOIN nucleus_alternative_points__minnie3_v1 USING (id);

views.name: nucleus_detection_lookup_v1
views.definition:
SELECT nucleus_detection_v0__minnie3_v1_merge.id,
    nucleus_detection_v0__minnie3_v1_merge.volume,
    nucleus_detection_v0__minnie3_v1_merge.pt_position,
    COALESCE(nucleus_alternative_points__minnie3_v1_merge.pt_root_id, nucleus_detection_v0__minnie3_v1_merge.pt_root_id) AS pt_root_id,
    nucleus_detection_v0__minnie3_v1_merge.pt_root_id AS orig_root_id,
    COALESCE(nucleus_alternative_points__minnie3_v1_merge.pt_supervoxel_id, nucleus_detection_v0__minnie3_v1_merge.pt_supervoxel_id) AS pt_supervoxel_id,
    COALESCE(nucleus_alternative_points__minnie3_v1_merge.pt_position, nucleus_detection_v0__minnie3_v1_merge.pt_position) AS pt_position_lookup
   FROM nucleus_detection_v0__minnie3_v1_merge
     LEFT JOIN nucleus_alternative_points__minnie3_v1_merge ON nucleus_alternative_points__minnie3_v1_merge.target_id = nucleus_detection_v0__minnie3_v1_merge.id;

views.name: nucleus_detection_v0__minnie3_v1_merge
views.definition:
SELECT nucleus_detection_v0.id,
    nucleus_detection_v0.created,
    nucleus_detection_v0.deleted,
    nucleus_detection_v0.superceded_id,
    nucleus_detection_v0.valid,
    nucleus_detection_v0.pt_position,
    nucleus_detection_v0.volume,
    nucleus_detection_v0.bb_start_position,
    nucleus_detection_v0.bb_end_position,
    nucleus_detection_v0__minnie3_v1.pt_supervoxel_id,
    nucleus_detection_v0__minnie3_v1.pt_root_id
   FROM nucleus_detection_v0
     JOIN nucleus_detection_v0__minnie3_v1 USING (id);

views.name: single_neurons
views.definition:
WITH merged AS (
         SELECT n.id,
            n.pt_position,
            n.pt_root_id,
            n.pt_supervoxel_id,
            r.cell_type
           FROM nucleus_detection_lookup_v1 n
             LEFT JOIN nucleus_ref_neuron_svm r ON n.id = r.target_id
        ), valid_pt_root_ids AS (
         WITH merged AS (
                 SELECT n.id,
                    n.pt_position,
                    n.pt_root_id,
                    n.pt_supervoxel_id,
                    r.cell_type
                   FROM nucleus_detection_lookup_v1 n
                     LEFT JOIN nucleus_ref_neuron_svm r ON n.id = r.target_id
                ), grouped_counts AS (
                 SELECT merged.pt_root_id,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE merged.cell_type::text = 'neuron'::text) AS neuron_count
                   FROM merged
                  GROUP BY merged.pt_root_id
                 HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE merged.cell_type::text = 'neuron'::text) = 1
                )
         SELECT grouped_counts.pt_root_id
           FROM grouped_counts
        )
 SELECT id,
    pt_root_id,
    pt_position,
    pt_supervoxel_id
   FROM merged m
  WHERE cell_type::text = 'neuron'::text AND (pt_root_id IN ( SELECT valid_pt_root_ids.pt_root_id
           FROM valid_pt_root_ids));

views.name: soma_counts
views.definition:
WITH merged AS (
         SELECT n.id,
            n.volume,
            n.pt_position,
            n.pt_root_id,
            n.orig_root_id,
            n.pt_supervoxel_id,
            n.pt_position_lookup,
            r.cell_type
           FROM nucleus_detection_lookup_v1 n
             LEFT JOIN nucleus_ref_neuron_svm r ON n.id = r.target_id
        ), grouped_counts AS (
         SELECT merged.pt_root_id,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE merged.cell_type::text = 'neuron'::text) AS neuron_count,
            count(*) AS total_count
           FROM merged
          GROUP BY merged.pt_root_id
        )
 SELECT m.id,
    m.pt_position,
    m.pt_root_id,
    m.pt_supervoxel_id,
    m.cell_type,
    g.neuron_count,
    g.total_count
   FROM merged m
     JOIN grouped_counts g ON m.pt_root_id = g.pt_root_id;

views.name: synapse_target_predictions_ssa_count_by_post
views.definition:
SELECT post_pt_root_id,
    count(
        CASE
            WHEN tag::text = 'soma'::text THEN 1
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END) AS count_soma,
    count(
        CASE
            WHEN tag::text = 'spine'::text THEN 1
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END) AS count_spine,
    count(
        CASE
            WHEN tag::text = 'shaft'::text THEN 1
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END) AS count_shaft
   FROM synapse_target_predictions_ssa_join
  GROUP BY post_pt_root_id;

views.name: synapse_target_predictions_ssa_count_by_pre
views.definition:
SELECT pre_pt_root_id,
    count(
        CASE
            WHEN tag::text = 'soma'::text THEN 1
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END) AS count_soma,
    count(
        CASE
            WHEN tag::text = 'spine'::text THEN 1
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END) AS count_spine,
    count(
        CASE
            WHEN tag::text = 'shaft'::text THEN 1
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END) AS count_shaft
   FROM synapse_target_predictions_ssa_join
  GROUP BY pre_pt_root_id;

views.name: synapse_target_predictions_ssa_join
views.definition:
SELECT s.id,
    s.pre_pt_position,
    s.ctr_pt_position,
    s.post_pt_position,
    s.size,
    s.pre_pt_supervoxel_id,
    s.pre_pt_root_id,
    s.post_pt_supervoxel_id,
    s.post_pt_root_id,
    stp.tag
   FROM ( SELECT synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.id,
            synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.created,
            synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.deleted,
            synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.superceded_id,
            synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.valid,
            synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.pre_pt_position,
            synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.ctr_pt_position,
            synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.post_pt_position,
            synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.size,
            synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.pre_pt_supervoxel_id,
            synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.pre_pt_root_id,
            synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.post_pt_supervoxel_id,
            synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge.post_pt_root_id
           FROM synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge) s
     JOIN synapse_target_predictions_ssa stp ON s.id = stp.target_id;

views.name: synapse_target_predictions_ssa_mv
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT 'tag'::text AS column_name,
    tag AS col_value
   FROM synapse_target_predictions_ssa
  WHERE tag IS NOT NULL;

views.name: synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge
views.definition:
SELECT synapses_pni_2.id,
    synapses_pni_2.created,
    synapses_pni_2.deleted,
    synapses_pni_2.superceded_id,
    synapses_pni_2.valid,
    synapses_pni_2.pre_pt_position,

    synapses_pni_2.post_pt_position,

    synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1.pre_pt_root_id,
    synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1.post_pt_supervoxel_id,
    synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1.post_pt_root_id
   FROM synapses_pni_2
     JOIN synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1 USING (id);

views.name: synapses_pni_2_in_degree
views.definition:
SELECT post_pt_root_id AS root_id,
    count(id) AS n_input,
    avg(size) AS avg_input_size
   FROM synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge
  WHERE pre_pt_root_id <> post_pt_root_id
  GROUP BY post_pt_root_id;

views.name: synapses_pni_2_in_out_degree
views.definition:
SELECT synapses_pni_2_in_degree.root_id,
    synapses_pni_2_in_degree.n_input,
    synapses_pni_2_in_degree.avg_input_size,
    synapses_pni_2_out_degree.n_output,
    synapses_pni_2_out_degree.avg_output_size
   FROM synapses_pni_2_in_degree
     JOIN synapses_pni_2_out_degree USING (root_id);

views.name: synapses_pni_2_out_degree
views.definition:
SELECT pre_pt_root_id AS root_id,
    count(id) AS n_output,
    avg(size) AS avg_output_size
   FROM synapses_pni_2__minnie3_v1_merge
  WHERE pre_pt_root_id <> post_pt_root_id
  GROUP BY pre_pt_root_id;

views.name: synapses_pni_2_v1_filtered_view
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    st_x(pre_pt_position) AS pre_pt_position_x,
    st_y(pre_pt_position) AS pre_pt_position_y,
    st_z(pre_pt_position) AS pre_pt_position_z,
    st_x(ctr_pt_position) AS ctr_pt_position_x,
    st_y(ctr_pt_position) AS ctr_pt_position_y,
    st_z(ctr_pt_position) AS ctr_pt_position_z,
    st_x(post_pt_position) AS post_pt_position_x,
    st_y(post_pt_position) AS post_pt_position_y,
    st_z(post_pt_position) AS post_pt_position_z,
    size,
    pre_pt_supervoxel_id,
    pre_pt_root_id,
    post_pt_supervoxel_id,
    post_pt_root_id

    s.deleted,
    s.superceded_id,
    s.valid,
    s.pre_pt_position,
    s.ctr_pt_position,
    s.post_pt_position,
